# Cunningham Falconer

> Brand design and illustration studio of Chris Shaw in Arvada, Colorado (studio since 2011). Chris takes brands off the screen and into the built world: signage, monuments, wayfinding, packaging and print. He also brands places, like master-planned communities, before they exist. Alongside that: gig posters, album art, festival design, flash and merch.

- Site: https://cunninghamfalconer.com/
- Brand case studies: https://work.cunninghamfalconer.com/
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/cunninghamfalconer
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/cunninghamfalconer
- Hire: https://cunninghamfalconer.com/#commission (projects start at $500)

## Branding
- I-40 Tradeport: Investor brochure and presentation. Investor brochure and presentation for a 4,000-acre industrial and logistics hub in Winslow, Arizona.
- NorthPark: Identity concepts, 2,100-acre community in Phoenix. Identity concepts for a 2,100-acre master-planned community in Phoenix.
- City of Englewood: Event campaigns, transit graphics and the 2018 Citizen Survey. Event campaigns, transit graphics and data design for the City of Englewood: 4th of July, the Block Party, Movies in the Park, the Englewood Trolley and the 2018 Citizen Survey results.
- Sunbreak Electric: Identity, website, cards and stickers
- Denver Wing Associates: Brand identity
- Clumsy Folks: Glassware brand and drops
